title: Create independent meeting labels and useful-attention outcomes
summary: Define and collect independently reviewed outcomes for anonymous consistency, procedure/floor/agenda transitions, fixed-pool identity decisions and useful attention. Machine hypotheses are not labels; uncertain/unresolvable cases and quiet misses remain visible.
in_scope: Annotation guide and reviewer data boundaries
out_of_scope: Using upstream accepted/reviewed machine status as gold
Hiding disputed labels or selecting only easy recurring speakers
Treating emitted hints as proven consumed/actionable
implementation: Write an annotation guide defining tasks, available evidence, temporal mode, uncertain/unresolvable outcomes and source-span labeling; freeze it before held-out inference.
Prepare separate reviewer packages from private sources with randomized case ordering and no experimental predicted answers; record reviewer identity/process and disagreements.
Collect independent floor/role/agenda and anonymous track-consistency labels plus verified identity labels only where separately supportable; adjudicate without silently forcing consensus.
Define useful attention as an evidenced contribution to a next check/decision, distinct from emission/consumption/action; review a sample of quiet cases for missed intervention.
Compute per-meeting/provenance-group quality, agreement and uncertainty and report sample support for unknown guests, overlaps, chair changes, shared mics and procedural exceptions.

Prepare independent annotation and report formats using existing DIAT tooling without waiting for the full generic evaluator; integrated comparisons remain gated by MAT-062 and its common split, outcome and leakage prerequisites.

acceptance.criterion: Reviewer labels are physically separate and cannot be read by the experiment builder or runner.
acceptance.verification: Run interface and sentinel checks before inference and verify labels are loaded only by the authorized reporting stage.

acceptance.criterion: Disagreement and unresolvable outcomes survive annotation and reporting.
acceptance.verification: Use conflicting reviewer examples and inspect both raw labels, adjudication reasons and excluded/unknown denominators.

acceptance.criterion: Metrics separate anonymous consistency, identity, procedure and attention.
acceptance.verification: Generate a report where these outcomes disagree and verify no single aggregate hides the distinction.

acceptance.criterion: Usefulness claims include quiet-case misses, timing and observed action scope.
acceptance.verification: Review emitted and withheld sample episodes with source evidence and record consumed/actioned/unknown independently.

tests: Two reviewers disagree about a chair handoff
Hint repeats what an agent/reviewer already knew
Quiet case contains a real missed contradiction
risks: Human labels may be uncertain even with source audio.
Familiar reviewers may recognize recurring people from context, so blind versus identity-enabled tasks need separate labels.

reuse.application: Reuse report-only ground truth, explicit execution mode and immutable package/label digests.
Reuse the separate empty labels template and source-view caveats.

sources: User clarification, 2026-10-08, active Matter build: DIAT owns meeting learning; roughly 315 hours/5–10 recurring people is user-reported; crawler owns jurisdiction knowledge; private exported-data experiments only.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (brainstorming, not implementation evidence).
